title: Design System: Melampus Local Tracing Platform

headline.purpose: Ordinary compact UI title; no display type role.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:var(--sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);font-size:13px;border: 1px solid #d8d5e2; border-radius: 5px; background: white; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 11px; line-height: 1.35; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms;background: var(--violet, #633da5); color: white; border-color: var(--violet, #633da5);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background: #4e2c88;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--violet, #633da5);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Tonal focus ring around the search control.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><input aria-label="Search function name or trace ID" placeholder="Search function name or trace ID…"></label>
components.css: .ds-search{font-family:var(--sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);font-size:13px;display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid #d8d5e2; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 10px; flex: 1; min-width: 160px;}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color: var(--violet, #633da5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--violet-soft, #f0ebf8);}.ds-search input{font-family:var(--sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);font-size:13px;min-width: 0; width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: none; font-size: 12px;}.ds-search input::placeholder{color: var(--muted, #676579);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Navigation selection
components.description: Active destination within the dark rail.
components.css: .ds-nav{background:var(--nav, #282035);padding:12px}.ds-navitem{font-family:var(--sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);font-size:13px;border: 0; background: transparent; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 10px; color: #ddd6e6; text-align: left; border-radius: 5px; margin-bottom: 3px;color: white; background: #634293;}.ds-navitem:hover{background: #3b2d4b; color: white;}.ds-navitem:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--violet, #633da5);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Active filter
components.description: Scoped filter with its removal control.
components.css: .ds-chip{font-family:var(--sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);font-size:13px;display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #dbd0ec; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 6px; background: var(--violet-soft, #f0ebf8); color: var(--violet-dark, #36234f); font-size: 11px;}.ds-chip svg{width: 11px; height: 11px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--violet, #633da5);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Overview frame
components.description: Flat chart and divided evidence frame.
components.css: .ds-overview{font-family:var(--sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);font-size:13px;border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e3ec); border-radius: 6px;background:var(--paper, #fff);color:var(--ink, #242333)}.ds-overview h2{font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0;padding:16px 18px}.ds-total{border-top:1px solid var(--line, #e4e3ec);padding:13px 18px}.ds-total span{display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted, #676579); margin-bottom: 3px;}.ds-total strong{font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;color:var(--red, #b93247)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
The platform is a compact operating surface for developers investigating code execution. Pale reading fields, dark violet navigation, fine rules, and restrained purple actions keep dense evidence legible. The user pinned the Datadog tracing explorer vocabulary; the identity and terminology are Melampus.

This record applies only to `src/melampus_platform/static/`. The separate `site/` OPSWAT marketing identity is outside scope. Evidence comes from `style.css`, `index.html`, and `app.js`, with confirmed language from `PRODUCT.md` and `.impeccable/surfaces/src-melampus-platform-static-index-html.md`. The build is code-led, with no approved raster comp or shipping raster assets.
keyCharacteristics: Dense tables and facets with persistent investigation context.
Labeled outcomes, mono identifiers, and tabular numeric evidence.
Flat reading surfaces; structural elevation for trace detail.

rules.name: The Labeled Evidence Rule
rules.body: Pair outcome colors with text labels; failures, errors, incomplete evidence, and evaluated passes remain distinct.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Use mono for code, function identifiers, and hashes; use tabular numerals for timing, counts, and trace facts.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep evidence tables and overview surfaces flat; reserve structural shadows for the trace panel and transient feedback.

dos: Do preserve the dense explorer, facets, time controls, and proportional waterfall.
Do keep Environment filtering available in mobile Filters.
Do preserve visible focus and restore matching controls after updates.
Do explicitly label synthetic traffic and platform self traces.
Do distinguish missing and suppressed evidence from evaluated passes.
donts: Don't introduce ornamental hero typography or marketing layouts into investigation screens.
Don't substitute color alone for an outcome label.
Don't invent intent prose, arguments, results, or exception messages absent from SDK evidence.
Don't apply this platform palette to the separate `site/` marketing surface.
